title: eria longissima
intro: Eria longissima, commonly known as the "Orchid Tree," is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce stress, making it an effective natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Eria longissima include its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Eria longissima also exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its potential in treating various health conditions.
